task.title: Exact UTF-8 text editing control
task.prompt: Read input.txt. This task has two declared phases. Initially create result.txt containing exactly OK followed by one LF newline. The fixed follow-up will ask you to edit that same file to remove the trailing newline, leaving exactly OK. Do only the initial phase now; do not run a command.

execution.instructions: Work only inside the supplied workspace with read/edit tools. Use write_file_exact for exact UTF-8 content; native line patches may add a newline. Follow the declared initial and fixed follow-up phases; do not do the follow-up early or execute commands.

rounds.prompt: Perform the declared fixed follow-up: read result.txt, then edit that same file to remove its trailing newline, leaving exactly OK with no newline. Do not execute commands.
